test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26th November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In an election between two candidates, 82% of voters cast their votes, out of which 4% were found to be invalid. The winning candidate got 108240 votes which are 55% of the valid votes. What was the total number of voters who cast their votes in this election?
solution:
Given:

Total votes casted = 82%

Total invalid votes = 4%

Votes received by the winning candidate = 108240

Winner's vote = 55% of valid votes

Calculation:

Considering the total voters to be 100%.

Percentage of valid votes = 82 - (82 × 4%)

⇒ 82 - 3.28 = 78.72%

Percentage of votes the winning candidate got = 78.72 × 55%

⇒ 43.296%

According to the question,

43.296% votes = 108240

⇒ 1% = 108240/43.296

⇒ 1% = 2500

∴ 100% = 250000

Number of vote casted = 250000 × 82/100

⇒ 205000

**∴ The total number of voters who casted their votes is 205000.**
